# jira.js

> Modern Jira REST API client for JavaScript and TypeScript. Covers the Jira Cloud platform REST API, the Jira Agile API and the Jira Service Management API. Runs in Node.js 22+ and browsers, ESM-only, promise-based and fully typed, with every response validated at runtime against a schema.

jira.js is an npm package (`npm install jira.js`) that wraps the Atlassian Jira Cloud REST APIs. Clients are built with factory functions — `createCloudClient`, `createAgileClient`, `createServiceDeskClient` — or composed from flat per-endpoint functions for smaller bundles. It supports Email + API token, bearer token, and OAuth 2.0 (3LO) authentication with automatic token refresh and cloud id resolution. Failures arrive as typed errors with predicates (`isNotFoundError`, `isRateLimitError`, …) rather than as transport errors.

Version 6.0 is a rewrite: one platform surface instead of v2/v3, `fetch` instead of axios, ESM only, and no JWT (Atlassian Connect) support. It is what `npm install jira.js` gives you. Integrations that need JWT stay on `jira.js@5`, which is supported until the end of 2026.

## Documentation

- [API reference](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/): Full TypeDoc reference for every endpoint, parameter, and model.
- [Getting started](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/getting-started): Install, build a client, make a first request.
- [Authentication](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/authentication): API token, bearer token, OAuth 2.0 (3LO).
- [Assets](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/assets): The configuration management database — the workspace a Cloud client needs, and why it does not answer on your site.
- [Teams](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/teams): Teams at organization level — why `orgId` is a parameter rather than client configuration, and why OAuth 2.0 is absent from the config type.
- [Tenant context](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/tenant-context): Resolving a site's `cloudId`, `orgId` and host name, which no REST endpoint returns.
- [Webhooks](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/webhooks): The other direction — the events, payloads and headers Jira posts to your server, as types only, and how much of that Atlassian actually documents.
- [OAuth 2.0 (3LO) guide](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/oauth2-authentication): Step-by-step setup with auto-refresh and cloudId resolution.
- [Error handling](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/error-handling): The typed error hierarchy and its predicates.
- [Response validation](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/response-validation): What happens when Jira sends a shape the schema does not describe, and how to configure it.
- [Tree-shaking](https://mrrefactoring.github.io/jira.js/guide/tree-shaking): Subpath exports and composing a minimal client.
- [Migrating to 6.0](https://github.com/MrRefactoring/jira.js/blob/master/MIGRATION.md): What changed, what was removed, and the codemod.
- [README](https://github.com/MrRefactoring/jira.js/blob/master/README.md): Overview, installation, quick start, supported APIs.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/MrRefactoring/jira.js/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): Release notes and version history.
